categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies connection manager (Connman) socket-event handling to disconnect on error events.
categories.rationale: Prevents potential CPU spinning and busy loops on select()-based platforms when peers send urgent data. As noted in the PR description, 'On select() based platform (BSDs, macOS and Windows), ErrorEvent can be returned if a peer sends us urgent data... we can't read that urgent data, and this means we could be continuously woken up.'

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches socket polling and event handling in the HTTP server (src/httpserver.cpp).
categories.rationale: Standardizes socket error handling in the HTTP server to halt operations and disconnect on ErrorEvent. While secondary to the peer-triggered P2P hazard, it prevents improper polling behavior and potential resource waste on HTTP sockets.
